activeSlice.scope: Correct the HI2-11R2 pre-gate exploration ratio without changing rollout policy: preserve parent Brand Brain topic labels for relevance/preference scoring while carrying an evidence-derived recommendation subject through Trend clustering and using that subject for final EEI diversity/topic-concentration accounting. This allows genuinely distinct stories under the same parent topic to coexist without weakening the 34% topic-share guard.
successCriteria: Trend clusters retain the existing parent topic in TrendIntelligence for relevance and preference matching.
Every Trend cluster also exposes a deterministic evidence-derived subject based on representative public evidence.
EEI recommendation topic/diversity accounting uses the evidence-derived subject rather than the coarse parent topic.
The existing maximumTopicShare=0.34 remains unchanged and is enforced over actual recommendation subjects.
The existing explorationMin=0.08 and explorationMax=0.20 remain unchanged.
With maxCandidates=6 and sufficient eligible evidence, one exploration recommendation can produce 1/6=16.7% exploration without violating topic concentration.
Regression tests prove distinct evidence subjects under the same parent Brand Brain topic are not falsely collapsed by the final topic-share guard.
Corrected 3x3 pre-gate reruns before any full 30-pair gate.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence or canary enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
